entities.name: PMID:27753678
observations: Veterans Affairs registry observational cohort (1999–2010) of 5,985 HIV/HCV-coinfected veterans; statin exposure was percentage of follow-up with active prescription.
Cirrhosis outcome was ICD-9 diagnosis or APRI >2; among participants with ALT ≤40 IU/L, each 30% increase in time on statin was associated with lower risk (HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.47–0.98).
Association was observational and subgroup-specific; it does not establish causality.

entities.name: Statin and cirrhosis risk
observations: In a cohort of 5,985 HIV/HCV-coinfected veterans, among those with ALT ≤40 IU/L, every 30% increase in time with an active statin prescription was associated with 32% lower cirrhosis hazard (HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.47–0.98); observational association only.
